bad_cases.question: Can tailored interventions increase mammography use among HMO women?
missing_claims: The effects of the intervention were most pronounced after the first intervention. Compared to usual care, telephone counseling seemed particularly effective at promoting change among nonadherent women, the group for whom the intervention was developed.
